integrity: Proof reconstructs the transfer-current matrix and all edge-type multiplicities; four exact grounded-Laplacian computations provide independent finite corroboration, not an all-order computer certificate.
scientific_limitations: Only canonical Euclidean orthogonal cut/cycle projections on incidence graphs of existing symmetric block designs; no universal minimum-projection claim, no intermediate-exponent evaluation, and no claim of design existence. Bibliographic equivalence outside the inspected sources remains a risk.
title: Design-universal endpoint Hodge projection norms for symmetric block incidences
